properties.name: SLH-DSA-SHA2-256f (Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Algorithm)
properties.complexity_bounds: O(2^h * K) hash calls, hypertree height h=66, d=22 layers, K=33 FORS trees
properties.algebraic_structure: SPHINCS+ framework over SHA-256, WOTS+ winternitz parameter w=16
properties.security_category: NIST Post-Quantum Category 5 (AES-256 equivalent, fast variant)

properties.name: SHA-256 Message Schedule Expansion and Compression
properties.complexity_bounds: Time: 64 rounds per 512-bit block; Space: 64 x 32-bit word schedule W[i]
properties.ring_modulus: GF(2^32) modular addition mod 2^32 and bitwise rotations
properties.algorithm_variant: Multi-buffer 4-way parallel SHA-256 processing via Intel SHA extensions

properties.name: Intel SHA Extensions (SHA-NI / AVX)
properties.throughput_bounds: 4 rounds of SHA-256 executed per 128-bit SIMD instruction cycle

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Perform 2 rounds of SHA-256 compression using state from xmm1 and xmm2, with precomputed message/constant sum in implicit register XMM0
Perform intermediate calculation of 4 message schedule doublewords W[i] to W[i+3] using values from xmm1 and xmm2

properties.operation: Drives WOTS+ and FORS hash-chain generation and Merkle tree node hashing

properties.vector_width: 4x 32-bit hash state variables (A, B, E, F) processed per 128-bit XMM lane

properties.stage: Inner loop compression step executing two SHA-256 transformation rounds
Message schedule expansion step updating 4 quadwords in place

properties.access_pattern: Read/Write 128-bit register containing state variables A, B, E, F and implicit XMM0 dependency
Read/Write 128-bit register holding message schedule words W[0..3]

evidence.reference: NIST FIPS 205: Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard
Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual, SHA Instruction Extensions Reference
